description: Change a webhook's name, URL, searchCriteria (null removes them), watch list (replaces the whole list) or status. status ACTIVE re-enables a PAUSED or FAILED webhook and re-queues its recent failed deliveries; PAUSED stops deliveries. Free.

searchCriteria.description: New criteria (same shape as lex_create_webhook), or null to remove.

url.description: Must be a public https URL.

name: lex_update_webhook
title: Update a webhook
